name: metrix-creative-engine
description: Turn an approved Metrix creative brief into finished ad assets through Kie.ai. The brief's declared format picks the route; the engine's skills render, assemble and review in order, and an MCP server gives them typed generation tools and a free brief check.

kie_api_key.title: Kie.ai API key
kie_api_key.description: Your own key from https://kie.ai/api-key. Leave empty to use KIE_AI_API_KEY from your environment instead.

runs_dir.title: Runs folder
runs_dir.description: Where generated assets, receipts and the task ledger are written. Leave empty to use KIE_AI_DOWNLOAD_DIR, or ./out in the folder Claude Code was started in.

assets_dir.title: Assets folder
assets_dir.description: Where your brand kits, product references, approved briefs and accepted media live. The skills read inputs from here. Leave empty to use METRIX_ASSETS_DIR from your environment, or the current folder.
